## History

As a member of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), Oliver Sloane participated in community projects alongside his peers. During a society meeting, he and the other members were appalled to discover that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) intended to rent his fence to a patent medicine company for advertising. Oliver later attended the meeting where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) reported her success in persuading Judson to cancel the advertising contract.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P2](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0002), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P6](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0006), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P11](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0011), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P13](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0013), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P17](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0017), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P18](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0018), +81 more_
